proposals.before: In the third month Song sent envoys seeking peace; Youzhou Prefecture prefect Yelü Changzhu was also made Palace Attendant to negotiate terms with Song.
proposals.after: In the third month Song sent envoys seeking peace; Zhuo Prefecture prefect Yelü Changzhu was also made Palace Attendant to negotiate terms with Song.
proposals.reason: Chinese 涿州刺史 is prefect of Zhuo Prefecture (Zhuozhou), not Youzhou.

proposals.before: In the third month Song sent envoys requesting peace; Youzhou Prefecture prefect Yelü Changzhu was additionally made Palace Attendant to negotiate peace with Song.
proposals.after: In the third month Song sent envoys requesting peace; Zhuo Prefecture prefect Yelü Changzhu was additionally made Palace Attendant to negotiate peace with Song.
proposals.reason: Chinese 涿州 is Zhuo Prefecture; Youzhou is a mistranslation.

proposals.before: On renwu day Han, under attack by Song, sent envoys begging aid; Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha and Prince of Ji Delie were ordered to march to their relief.
proposals.after: On renwu day Han, under attack by Song, sent envoys begging aid; Southern Court chancellor Yelü Sha and Prince of Ji Dilie were ordered to march to their relief.
proposals.reason: Same person 敵烈 was romanized Dilie earlier in the chapter; Delie is inconsistent spelling.

decisions.reason: 涿州刺史 names Zhuo Prefecture (涿州), not Youzhou (幽州); the proposed replacement corrects that place-name error without changing the rest of the sentence.
Same unit: 涿州 is Zhuo Prefecture; Youzhou is a mistranslation of a different place name.
冀王敵烈 is the same Prince of Ji already rendered Dilie elsewhere; Delie misreads 敵 (dí) and breaks chapter naming consistency.
